verdict.rationale: Whether a software product publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for a government tax-filing portal and app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows ELSTER's source code being public or openly licensed. The ERiC developer-artifact host is a distribution channel for integration bundles, not open source, and it did not respond in the latest probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
